facts.text: The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet with a large hero image at the top, three full-body turnaround panels in the middle row, and four detail crops in the bottom row.
In the top hero panel, a person stands on a wet surface between metal railings at night; rain streaks are visible, and city lights and building facades are in the background.
The hero figure wears a black tactical jacket with chest straps and buckles, a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black combat boots; the pose is upright with the head turned toward frame left.
The middle row is labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK, showing the same figure in full body against a plain dark gray backdrop with arms at his sides.
The bottom row is labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The FACE crop shows a close-up of the man's face with a serious, direct gaze, dark hair shaved at the sides and gathered at the back, and a distinct mark or slit through one eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR crop shows black fabric, a strap, and a rectangular metal buckle.
The HANDS crop shows two hands close together with pronounced veins and skin texture.
The BOOTS crop shows worn black leather lace-up combat boots.
The hero panel uses cool blue-gray night tones with rain and warm amber lights, while the turnaround and detail panels use low-key lighting on a dark gray backdrop.
